envelope: controller envelope (kind run) | the controller; envelope frame; shape golden
observer_report: observer report (nested envelope) | the observer; envelope frame; its own observer_schema_version (OBSERVER_SCHEMA_VERSION) inside

validator_wire: validator NDJSON (probes and verdicts) | host and validator, co-shipped in one bundle; NDJSON; kind sb_api_validator_verdict; no version marker The wire carries no version marker; the Known gap below the figure says what holds this boundary instead.

B5 plan; strict NDJSON
reply: runner reply (PWRunnerRunResult) | the host; response schema; shape golden

B4 release/acquire; proceed first

B7: exact response version; disposition validated and projected; reply retained unread when refused |

B12: admitted only after successful application, worker completion, PID, nonce, input identity and payload integrity checks |
